target.statement: GSFM achieves J&F of 86.2 on DAVIS2017 val, outperforming STCN baseline by 1.5

compute.basis: Training requires 8 V100 GPUs for 24 hours; on a CPU-only laptop, training would be infeasible, and even inference on DAVIS2017 val would take hours.

blockers: Training requires 8 V100 GPUs (32GB each) for 24 hours
No pre-trained model provided in the repository
Large datasets (YouTube-VOS, DAVIS) require significant disk space and download time
title: Global Spectral Filter Memory Network for Video Object Segmentation
